1.title: State Dept. Declares U.S. Citizen in China Wrongfully Detained
1.summary: U Min Zin, a scholar who studied Myanmar, is one of two U.S. citizens the department has designated as wrongfully detained in China.

2.title: Under Trump, Protected Wild Horses Are Going to Slaughter
2.summary: A legal loophole allows the government to sell mustangs on the cheap, stripping them of protections and clearing their path to destruction.

3.title: Senate Health Panel Chairman Voices Strong Reservations About F.D.A. Nominee
3.summary: Senator Bill Cassidy said Dr. Heidi Overton’s role in President Trump’s executive order on vaccines last week was “almost disqualifying.”

4.title: At least 13 workers killed in landslide at Colombian gold mine
4.summary: Four members of an indigenous family are among the dead, witnesses said.

5.title: After Six Years, Harry and Meghan Are Coming Home. What Changed?
5.summary: Just last year, Prince Harry said he couldn’t imagine ever bringing his family back to Britain.

6.title: Missile Barrage Shows Russia’s Doubt That Ukraine Can Defend Itself
6.summary: Moscow is taking advantage of Ukraine’s depleted stock of interceptors and is intensifying attacks, worsening the civilian death toll.
